Infrastructure

World-Class Facilities

Samarpan Hospital offers a comprehensive range of medical infrastructure designed to provide the highest quality of care in a comfortable and safe environment.

30 Bed Hospital

Modern facility equipped with varied room categories from General to Super Deluxe.

Dialysis Facility

Operating in 3 shifts with advanced HDF Dialysis capabilities for better toxin removal.

ICU & Critical Care

Fully equipped Intensive Care Unit with ventilators and cardiac monitors.

Modular OT

State-of-the-art modular operation theater for safe surgical procedures.

Emergency Setup

24×7 availability for Emergency, Pharmacy, and Ambulance services.

In-house Diagnostics

Complete pathology lab and diagnostic services available within the premises.
